items.note: Five classroom experiments in which student groups completed design assignments with or without GAI tools, and solutions were evaluated for creativity; group-level unit, assignment method and N not stated in the abstract.

Current Opinion in Psychology review of gains and costs of collaborating with GenAI on creative work, with four moderators; narrative, not systematic or meta-analytic, but a useful pointer list for references.

98 advertising professionals randomly assigned to no GenAI, GenAI, or GenAI after prompt training for an ideation task; outcomes are idea counts and rated creativity ('perceived creativity' may be rater-judged; check full text).

Responses from three ChatGPT versions compared with human responses on open and closed creative tasks, rated blind by 738 raters (4,428 evaluations); no participant uses AI; same study as SSRN 4686415.

Expert and nonexpert users write ad copy without an LLM, with an LLM as ghostwriter, or with an LLM as sounding board; quality measured by real social-media clicks plus semantic divergence analysis; N and assignment not in abstract.

Abstract not reachable (OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, Crossref, Springer page all failed); title suggests students use personalized GenAI with creative performance, self-efficacy and attention (eye-tracking?) outcomes, comparison condition unknown.

Eight-week high-school study: both groups work with GenAI, experimental group (n=38) also gets metacognitive scaffolding vs control (n=32); creative performance scored; contrast is scaffolding, not AI configuration, so eligibility is doubtful; search notes say quasi-experiment.

Two experiments: Exp 1 participants collaborate with a human partner or an LLM partner on simple and complex creative tasks; Exp 2 compares batch-responsive vs constrained-responsive LLMs; individual creative performance scored; N not in abstract.

12-week quasi-experiment with 3 vocational-school classes (75 students): no GenAI, GenAI, GenAI plus teacher structure support; creativity scored on fluency, flexibility, elaboration, originality pre and post; class-level non-random assignment.

Difference-in-differences on 43,587 designers after a platform added a GAI illustration tool; the outcome is the number of original-work postings and domain reallocation, with no novelty, diversity or originality measure in the abstract.
